This '''cousin''' of [[Walon Vau]] was an [[Irmenu]] noble who gained Walon's inheritance and the title of [[Count of Gesl]] after Walon was disowned by his family for joining the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. Vau later robbed him of his fortune after he plundered the vault of the Counts of Gesl in the [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]] on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to regain his inheritance.
